infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Full Scale scans your room and objects with the camera and LiDAR.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Full Scale listens for voice commands to place and search for objects.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Full Scale transcribes your voice commands on-device.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Full Scale uses Location Services so a room scan can align to true north.
